Read and follow `AGENTS.md`.

This checkout is the `agent-starter` curated catalog. Its maintained plugin source is `plugins/agent-engineering-system/`; the root `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` is the generated Claude marketplace view.
Use the catalog's maintained `agent-engineering-system` plugin for reusable `code-quality` and `semantic-architecture` skills.
